title: The Morning Bird (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate garden morning Perth Zimbabwe birds seasons
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The morning bird knows things I don't know about the day
It's been awake for an hour before I find my way
To the garden and it's already done a full report
On the state of the garden and the temperature and short

[Pre-Chorus]
I learned the names of thirty birds in the garden over years
And the birds didn't change their schedule through all the career

[Chorus]
The morning bird, the morning bird
The first announcement of the day without a word
That I could speak — its language is not mine
But its meaning is quite clear in the morning light's design
The gardens still growing

[Verse 2]
The willy wagtail woke me up this morning at five forty
By conducting an urgent assessment extremely early
Of the roses at the south end of the garden near the wall
The willy wagtail is never late and never misses a call

[Bridge]
In Zimbabwe the birds were different but the same understanding
Applied — the birds knew the time before the clocks were landing
In the kitchen and the birds were doing what they did
And I would listen from my bed and know that morning bid
Itself awake

[Outro]
Morning bird knows the garden is awake… the garden knows the bird…
The gardens still growing
